integrity: A full analytical proof and finite independently coded numerical corroboration are provided; the latter is not an exhaustive or infinite proof. Equivalent unindexed literature remains possible.
limitations: Rotation-invariant Borel sampling measures on a finite-dimensional Euclidean unit ball; affine least-squares projection evaluated over the entire ball; prescribed positive radial second moment. No nonsymmetric designs or higher polynomial degrees.
title: Sharp two-shell radial sampling laws for affine least-squares extrapolation
